steps.title: The browser remembers your passwords
steps.body: Sign in to a site in a drawer tab and the drawer offers to save the password; sign in with a new one and it asks to update it. Next time it offers to fill the login, or tap the lock in the address bar. They stay on this computer, encrypted for your account on it, as Chrome keeps them. Chats never see them.

keys.text: after you sign in (needs your PIN to be set)
on a sign-in page, or the lock in the address bar
in the drawer's menu: see one (with your PIN) or delete it
